title: Dependence ratio
description: Ratio of older (65+) and young (0-15) people relative to working-age population

title: Median age of population
description: Median age — indicates population ageing and demographic structure

title: Old-age dependency ratio
description: Ratio of older people (65+) relative to working-age population

title: Young-age dependency ratio
description: Ratio of young people (0-15) relative to working-age population

title: Average population
description: Average population in a given year

title: Crude net migration rate
description: Net migration per a thousand population capturing mobility and migration pressure

title: Crude rate of population growth
description: Total population change per average population

title: Crude rate of natural population change
description: Natural increase (or decrease) — births minus deaths per population isolating demographic change not due to migration

title: Crude rate of total population change
Pension replacement rate by sex
description: Ratio between the first pension and the last wage obtained by the worker
